row.proto: void **Vm_FindOrCreate_TypedChildByName_14161e7f0(void *registry, void **parent_handle, const char *name, void *value, int32_t set_if_found)
row.notes: Whole body read. Rejects a null name, a null parent and names containing '#', '.', '[' or ']'; hashes the name with djb2 (seed 0x1505, x33) and looks the child up (Vm_Find_ChildNodeByNameHash for list parents). A found child must have type descriptor 0x14612b9f8, and if set_if_found == 1 its value is set from value (0x14161e4c0). Otherwise it allocates a 0x68-byte node from the registry allocator, constructs it with hash and value (0x14161ec00) and adds it with Vm_Node_InsertChildAtIndex(-1) or Vm_Node_AddKeyedChild; on failure the node is destroyed. Returns the node handle or the empty handle 0x146067080. Caller Ui_Rnd_SetDepartmentPipColourA passes a 0x20-byte value (0,1.0f,0,1.0f pattern) with set_if_found 1 and stores the handle in the holder at view+0x1a0. Caller 0x14158eeb0: screen init, binds child 0x145613725 into holder +0xe50. Caller 0x141e71490: same pattern into holder +0xe0. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
